notes: Five-arm pre-execution pilot scaffold for measuring failure-memory transfer and direct H1 decision-memory behavior beyond workflow-only harness guidance. The catalog price-policy and catalog replenishment-policy tasks are tagged with record_consistency because their required adopted policies exist only in decision-bearing arms. Schema oracles on API convention-transfer tasks are tagged as mistake_prevention because the visible failure records target response-key and metadata-envelope drift. Measurement pilots should run without --stop-on-abnormal so abnormal events are measured rather than censored.
